CREATE TABLE diary_entry_tag ( entry_id BIGINT NOT NULL, tag_id BIGINT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_diary_entry_tag PRIMARY KEY (entry_id, tag_id), CONSTRAINT fk_entry_tag_entry FOREIGN KEY (entry_id) REFERENCES diary_entry (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_entry_tag_tag FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tag (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT );
CREATE INDEX idx_entry_tag_entry ON diary_entry_tag (entry_id); CREATE INDEX idx_entry_tag_tag ON diary_entry_tag (tag_id);
